config.hypothesis: With architecture and causal retrieval fixed, giving complementary errors and preservation conflicts explicit loss mass can improve use of historical evidence relative to equally trained current-only heads.
config.motivation: The fixed 16-log training audit found 101693 supported repair queries (96002 with strict same-object/same-stuff evidence), but their existing weighted loss mass was 8.77%. This suggests a supervision test; it does not establish optimization failure or expected success.
config.training_selection: Exactly the original instance-memory-20261029 sixteen train logs / 642 frames. First frame of each log initializes history only, leaving 626 supervised frames. No additional training sequences selected from their outcomes.
config.development_selection: The eight already inspected independent_dev_added logs / 321 frames. They are development data, not an untouched confirmation set. Four followup holdout logs remain closed.
config.feature_policy: Current frozen B0 PTv3 with all serialization shuffling disabled, raw nuScenes keyframes with supplied ego poses, remission divided by 255. One shared extraction for all arms. Fixed seed-0 current-only anchor from the existing real_pilot run is shared by all arms and seeds; its legacy training feature policy is explicitly disclosed, never silently relabeled.
config.architecture: Unmodified CurrentAnchoredRepair / JointRepair: 64 feature dimensions, 64 hidden units, 15760 trainable repair parameters; 4096 query cap, confidence 0.9, 0.5/1.5 m radii, 0.7 cosine, previous raw frame, 0.75 s expiry, 2*tanh residual. No new head, memory capacity, inference threshold or training backbone.
config.fairness: Factorial current/temporal x standard/balanced supervision. Same query indices, same current-anchor checkpoint, same training labels, initial repair parameters, frames, optimizer steps and five epochs for all four arms. Training group membership is computed once from the frozen temporal candidates and shared with the current-only arm; it is a training-only weight, never an inference input.

groups.repair: Valid query, frozen current anchor wrong, at least one valid past raw probability argmax equals the training target class, and anchor maximum logit minus target logit is strictly less than 2*residual_limit (4). This uses the existing correction range, not a searched threshold; ties/irreparable queries remain supervised in other.
groups.preserve: Valid query, frozen current anchor correct, and at least one valid past raw probability argmax differs from the training target class.
groups.other: All remaining valid queries, including absent history. The three groups are mutually exclusive and cover every supervised query. No GT instance filter changes inference candidates.

config.standard_loss: Existing train-class-weighted CE + 0.5 wrong-class margin repair + 0.5 correct-class margin retention, normalized across the frame. Class weights normalize over observed training classes only, then retain the existing [0.25,4] clipping; absent classes have zero weight.
config.balanced_loss: For each nonempty group in a frame, compute the SAME class-weighted loss mean, then average those group means equally. Do not amplify an empty group. No selected class, confidence cutoff, resampling or post-result coefficient tuning.
config.checkpoint_selection: Best development native16 full-point mIoU independently for each arm/seed; all epochs remain reported. Main candidate is fixed now, not selected among output rules after seeing results.
config.counterfactuals: For each selected temporal head, also evaluate the identical weights with the current token only. Distinguish direct use of history from improvement caused by supervision/current learning. No-history inputs use the existing original current-only encoding.
config.cache: The frozen encoder, anchor, retrieval and fixed similarity pooling make JointRepair's input vector independent of trainable repair weights. Cache exact float32 vectors and anchors, with current-token reconstruction verified against the actual current-only forward input. Network outputs must match the original fusion on sampled real frames before using this optimization. Do not cache fused outputs as history. Use an owned temporary cache, at most 4 GiB, and remove it after preserving reproducible results/checkpoints.
config.report: All seeds and arms, same-forward raw/anchor/current-image controls where available, full-point native16 mIoU, class IoUs, camera foreground accuracy, per-log and per-object fixes/harms, GT-defined first-observation/reappearance/baseline-error-recovery outcomes with censoring. Report group counts and loss fractions; these do not substitute for accuracy.
config.development_gate: For the fixed balanced-temporal candidate: mean mIoU gain >=0.05 pp over the best current-only control, positive gain in every seed and at least five of eight logs per seed; camera foreground loss <=0.1 pp versus the best current control in every seed; mean baseline-error-recovery success no worse than the best current-only control. Failure stops this supervision experiment without epoch/loss/radius/threshold search or holdout access.
config.delivery: Development gates only authorize fresh joint replay and latency verification. Preserve the existing 5 ms median anchor-plus-repair module target, report p95, and separately require actual online throughput/queue/drop checks. Cached-head training or timing cannot prove online realtime or instance consistency. New raw-feature checkpoints remain deployable=false until their actual worker contract and joint behavior are verified.
